# Deck instructions

This folder is a Live-ish deck: scripted demos of code and UI, driven by a clicker. The engine is the `@live-ish/engine` package. This folder holds the content.

## Rules

- Use `live-ish new` to create slides. Do not hand-write engine internals.
- Edit only `slides/`, `demos/`, `themes/`, `public/` and `deck.config.ts`.
- Never edit `app/`, `next.config.ts`, `.live-ish/` or `node_modules/`.
- Run `live-ish check --json` after each change, and fix what it reports.
- Take browser support from `live-ish support`. Never state it from memory.
- Do not deploy unless the user asks.
- Speaker notes are the author's words. Ask before rewriting them.

If `check` fails twice on the same issue, stop and report it.

## Commands

Run `live-ish` through the deck's package manager: `pnpm live-ish check`, or `npx live-ish check`.

- `pnpm dev` serves the deck at <http://localhost:3000/present>.
- `live-ish check --json` runs the validators. Exit 0 passes, 1 means findings, 2 misuse, 3 environment.
- `live-ish new copy "Title"`, `new web-demo <id>` and `new terminal-demo <id>` add content. Add `--json` to read the paths they wrote.
- `live-ish record <id>` records a terminal demo from its `session.txt`.
- `live-ish explain <rule>` explains a finding, offline.
- `live-ish actions --json` lists the step actions and the assert grammar.
- `live-ish themes --json` lists the audience themes.
- `live-ish support "<feature>" --json` searches the installed browser support data.
- `live-ish schema` writes JSON Schemas to `.live-ish/schema/`.

## Code style

- A copy slide is one `slides/NN-name.ts` with a default `defineSlide()`.
- A demo is one folder, `demos/<id>/`, with `demo.ts`, plain files under `before/` and `after/`, and `hooks.js`.
- Keep shown code to 44 columns and 40 lines. Use `excerpt()` to show part of a longer file.
- Write notes as the speaker would say them, one idea per paragraph.

## Testing

- `live-ish check --json` is the test. A change is not done until it exits 0.
- With `@live-ish/verify` installed, `live-ish walk <id>` plays a demo in a browser. `live-ish add verify` installs it.

## Security

- Ask before running a command the user did not write. `live-ish record` runs each line of `session.txt`.
- Keep credentials out of `session.txt` and out of `public/`. Stop if `record` reports a token.
- Deployed builds leave speaker notes out. Leave `presenter.onHost` and `reader.notes` off unless the user asks.

## Skills

`.agents/skills/` and `.claude/skills/` are generated from the engine. `live-ish upgrade` refreshes them. It keeps a file you edited, puts the new version in `.live-ish/skills-incoming/<name>/`, and leaves a skill you deleted deleted.

Nothing here is required. A deck builds and presents with no agent files at all.
